in_hebrew.name: Gayleen
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Joyful hidden one
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gayleen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Gayleen is derived from the Greek word 'gaios' meaning joyful and 'leos' meaning hidden. In ancient Greece, this name was given to a child who was believed to bring joy and happiness to those around them, while also being hidden or protected from harm.
